overview.en: An alternate reality game about our desire for answers. A university recruitment poster leads into emails, Python assignments, and a fictional school portal, where the familiar promise of progress slowly begins to fail.
overview.zh: 一场关于寻找答案的另类实境游戏。玩家从一张大学招生海报出发，循着邮件、Python 作业和校园网站寻找线索，却发现努力并不总能换来进展。

design_question.en: Can a digital system make absurdity something we experience?
design_question.zh: 数字系统能否让人切身体会到荒诞？

paragraphs.en: I began with the language of an academic institution: a recruitment poster, a contact address, and an automatic reply from an absent professor. The email leaves a programming assignment. These ordinary details make the invitation credible before anything seems wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 向海报上的邮箱发信，会收到一封自动回复：教授暂时离校，留下一份编程作业。招生海报、联系邮箱与来信，这些寻常细节让虚构的学校显得可信。

caption.zh: Leet Code Academy 招生海报

paragraphs.en: The player is asked to repair a weighted-average function in Python. Its hidden grader tests random inputs against the arbitrary answer 42, so even a correct function can fail. Inspired by Camus, I made repetition part of the experience: progress begins when the player questions the test itself. A comment inside the grader points beyond the assignment.
paragraphs.zh: 任务要求修复 Python 的加权平均函数，但隐藏的评分程序无论随机生成什么输入，都把 42 当作预期答案。函数写对了，测试也可能失败。加缪笔下的重复与受挫由此成为游戏体验；下一步的线索藏在代码注释里，提示玩家跳出题目，重新审视测试本身。

paragraphs.en: I designed the website to resemble an outdated university portal. Missing courses and scattered bold letters turn its bureaucracy into a puzzle, bringing the email and assignment together. An AI assistant offers hints and asks questions about meaning; players who keep requesting the login details can also reach the ending through conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 网站刻意模仿老旧的大学门户。查不到的课程、散落的粗体字母，让繁琐的页面成为谜题，也串起邮件与作业中的线索。AI 助手既提供提示，也会追问意义是什么；反复询问登录信息，还能通过对话进入结尾。

caption.en: Leet Code Academy homepage and helper chatbot
caption.zh: Leet Code Academy 首页与聊天助手

paragraphs.en: Behind the student login is John Smith, the fictional professor, now speaking through an AI chatbot. The final encounter opens a conversation about absurdity instead of resolving the puzzles into one answer. I wanted the tension between our need for clarity and an indifferent system to remain with the player after the game ends.
paragraphs.zh: 登录后，虚构教授 John Smith 以 AI 聊天机器人的身份出现，将解谜带向一场关于荒诞的对话。结尾没有标准答案。我希望玩家在离开游戏后，仍会想起这段经历：人渴望清晰的解释，系统却始终漠然。

caption.en: An excerpt from the final conversation with John Smith
caption.zh: 与 John Smith 的最终对话节选
Jupyter Notebook 中的编程作业

process_note.en: The missing course is CSE 1A. Bold letters across the site spell “meaning”; encoding it in Base64 gives the password. The username, “lukewam,” is hidden in the URL.
process_note.zh: 课程目录里找不到 CSE 1A。各页的粗体字母拼出“meaning”，将这个词转为 Base64 编码，便能得到密码。用户名“lukewam”藏在网址中。

subtitle.en: A mobile game prototype for climate action
subtitle.zh: 鼓励气候行动的手机游戏原型

role.zh: 原型与界面开发负责人

overview.en: Care for a virtual polar bear by completing small climate-friendly actions in daily life. Our Tamagotchi-inspired prototype turns those actions into coins for food and clothing, giving players a companion to return to.
overview.zh: 完成日常环保任务，赚取金币，为虚拟北极熊购买食物和服装。原型借鉴了 Tamagotchi，通过照顾宠物，鼓励玩家坚持环保行动。

paragraphs.en: Our survey reached more than 100 people, primarily Gen Z students. Many already took small climate-friendly actions but wanted encouragement to keep going; educational games often felt unappealing. We considered racing, a recycling RPG, and a digital pet. The pet offered a clear connection between everyday action and care, within a scope our team could prototype.
paragraphs.zh: 问卷收集了 100 多人的反馈，受访者多是 Z 世代学生。许多人已经会做一些环保小事，却缺少坚持的动力，也觉得教育游戏不够有趣。团队比较了赛车、回收主题 RPG 和电子宠物三个方案，最终选择宠物养成：行动与照料的关系直观，也适合当时的原型开发规模。

caption.en: Large-scale and small-scale climate action survey results
caption.zh: 不同规模气候行动的问卷结果

paragraphs.en: In Figma, we tested two versions of customization, task progress, and task history. I designed Flow B. We recorded completion times, self-ratings, and comments during task-based sessions. The feedback favored B as the more intuitive option, helping us choose which flow to develop further.
paragraphs.zh: 团队在 Figma 中为装扮、任务进度和历史记录制作了 A、B 两套流程，其中 B 版由我设计。测试记录了完成时间、参与者自评与反馈。B 版被认为更容易上手，因此成为后续完善的方向。

caption.en: Task history and calendar low-fidelity wireframes
caption.zh: 任务记录与日历线框图

paragraphs.en: The resulting home screen brings tasks, progress, and streaks together. I designed the feeding and customization systems, including the inventory, icons, items, and tasks. A food shop, friends page, and profile extend the same daily loop: choose an action, earn coins, and spend time with the bear.
paragraphs.zh: 首页集中展示任务、进度和连续打卡记录。负责设计的喂养与装扮系统包括物品栏、图标、道具和任务，并与食物商店、好友页和个人资料相连：完成行动，赚取金币，再回来照顾北极熊。

caption.en: Home: the bear, streaks, and task progress
caption.zh: 首页：北极熊、打卡记录与任务进度

caption.en: Final food shop and feeding screen
My Beloved Polar Bear two-phone mockup

design_question.en: What might make someone want to return to a small good habit?
design_question.zh: 怎样让人愿意坚持一个好习惯？

caption.zh: 回收游侠瑞奇 — 概念设计：Luke Wang

caption.en: The complete home screen and daily task list
caption.zh: 完整首页与每日任务清单

role.zh: 交互设计与测试负责人

overview.en: A Meta Quest 2 game set in an urban disaster scene. Players locate injured people, select first-aid items, and follow guided actions against the clock. I led interaction design and testing, from controller input to hand tracking.
overview.zh: 这款 Meta Quest 2 游戏模拟城市灾后救援。玩家要在限定时间内找到伤者、选择急救物品，并按指引操作。交互设计与测试从手柄操作入手，再逐步扩展到手部追踪。

paragraphs.en: I built a medical-room prototype in Unity and C# to develop selection, object manipulation, and movement. A controller ray selects items and points to teleport destinations. Directional arrows lead toward injured people, while a menu lets players choose equipment and enter text.
paragraphs.zh: 最初用 Unity 和 C# 搭建医疗室原型，实现物品选择、操作和移动。手柄射线既可选取物品，也可指定传送位置；箭头引导玩家找到伤者，菜单则用于选择器材和输入文字。

title.en: Keeping the menu with the player

paragraphs.en: Testing exposed a practical issue: the menu needed to stay usable as the player moved. I attached it to the player model, adjusted its height dynamically, and hid it when unused. That kept the same tools available throughout the scene without leaving the menu permanently in view.
paragraphs.zh: 测试中发现，玩家移动时，菜单也需要保持在便于操作的位置。将菜单绑定到玩家模型，并动态调整高度后，就能随时调用工具；不用时则隐藏菜单，减少视线遮挡。

caption.en: Patient and medical equipment input flow
caption.zh: 伤者与医疗器材输入流程

paragraphs.en: We then mapped hand gestures to the existing controls with the Meta Interaction SDK. Some gestures were difficult for the headset to recognize, so I focused on simple, distinct movements. The work became a balance between what felt understandable to the player and what the tracking system could reliably distinguish.
paragraphs.zh: 随后通过 Meta Interaction SDK，将手势对应到已有操作。由于部分动作难以稳定识别，设计时优先选择简单、差异明显的手势：既要让玩家容易理解，也要让头显能够分辨。

caption.en: Hand gestures keyboard and teleport interaction flow
caption.zh: 手势、键盘与传送操作流程
通过手部追踪操作虚拟键盘

design_question.en: How can selecting, moving, and finding help feel clear inside VR?
design_question.zh: 在 VR 中，如何让选取物品、移动和寻找伤者都容易上手？

subtitle.en: A small vehicle learning to read a track

role.en: Hardware design and tracking software development lead
role.zh: 硬件设计与循迹开发负责人

overview.en: A camera-equipped vehicle built to follow a track and respond to signs. I constructed its hardware and developed the tracking software, moving from recorded driving demonstrations toward explicit color-based responses in OpenCV.
overview.zh: 一辆装有摄像头的小车，学习沿赛道行驶并响应路标。硬件搭建与循迹软件由我负责，先用驾驶示范训练模型，再通过 OpenCV 设置基于颜色的响应规则。

paragraphs.en: I assembled and wired the vehicle, designed its laser-cut acrylic chassis in LightBurn, and modeled protective housings in Blender for 3D printing. NVIDIA hardware, a camera, front depth sensing, and a central VESC motor controller formed the platform. A laptop connection provided live video and manual driving with arrow keys.
paragraphs.zh: 亚克力底盘用 LightBurn 设计并激光切割，保护外壳则在 Blender 中建模、3D 打印。小车搭载 NVIDIA 硬件、摄像头、前置深度传感器与 VESC 电机控制器。完成组装与接线后，连接笔记本即可查看实时画面，用方向键手动驾驶。

caption.en: Front sensor mounting and cable routing
caption.zh: 前置传感器的固定与走线

title.zh: 用 30 圈驾驶训练模型

paragraphs.en: I collected 30 laps of manual driving under different lighting conditions, trained the model on a remote server, and deployed it to the vehicle. Track reflections disrupted its performance, so I repeated the training process. Lighting became a practical part of the problem, not just a background condition.
paragraphs.zh: 在不同光照下手动驾驶 30 圈，用采集的数据在远程服务器上训练模型，再部署到小车。赛道反光会干扰行驶，因此又进行了多轮训练。光照变化成了实际测试中绕不开的问题。

caption.en: Onboard training footage from the marked track, with curves and strong window light.
caption.zh: 车载镜头记录了赛道弯道和窗边强光下的训练过程。

caption.en: A second training recording on tiled flooring, using blue tape to mark the route.
caption.zh: 另一段训练录像，路线由瓷砖地面上的蓝色胶带标出。

paragraphs.en: We reworked the approach in OpenCV so responses could be programmed more directly. I wrote the color detection: white marked track edges, black the driving surface, light blue the boundary, and red a stop cue. This gave the team more control over behaviors such as stopping, parking, speeding up, and slowing down.
paragraphs.zh: 随后用 OpenCV 调整方案，让小车按识别到的颜色作出响应。颜色检测程序将白色视为赛道边缘、黑色视为路面、浅蓝色视为边界，红色作为停止信号。这样便能更直接地设置停止、泊车、加速和减速等行为。

caption.en: Vehicle acrylic chassis and printed component housings
caption.zh: 亚克力底盘与 3D 打印外壳

design_question.en: What changes when a driving model meets a reflective, unevenly lit track?
design_question.zh: 赛道反光、光照不均时，驾驶模型会怎样表现？

caption.en: The laser-cut acrylic platform before fitting the electronics
caption.zh: 安装电子部件前的激光切割亚克力平台

subtitle.en: An Android app for planning a zoo visit
subtitle.zh: 规划动物园行程的 Android 应用

overview.en: Choose the animals you want to see, then find a route through the San Diego Zoo. I led the search and navigation backend for an Android app that turns a list of favorite exhibits into a visit plan.
overview.zh: 选好想看的动物，就能规划圣地亚哥动物园的游览路线。这款 Android 应用把展区清单变成行程计划，搜索与导航后端由我负责。

title.en: From search to a visit list

paragraphs.en: The search accepts partial animal names, so visitors can find exhibits without typing a complete name. They add the places they want to visit, then choose between detailed navigation and a simpler guide. I was responsible for the search and navigation systems behind this flow.
paragraphs.zh: 输入动物名称的一部分，就能找到对应展区。将想去的地点加入清单后，可以选择详细导航或更简洁的导览，按计划开始游览。

title.en: Turning the map into a graph

paragraphs.en: We manually imported the zoo map as connected locations and roads. Each road carries a distance, allowing Dijkstra’s algorithm to calculate shortest paths from the visitor’s location. This is the foundation for navigation between selected stops.
paragraphs.zh: 地图由团队手动录入，地点与道路组成路径图，每条道路带有距离权重。Dijkstra 算法据此计算从当前位置出发的最短路径，帮助游客在所选展区之间导航。

title.en: Testing the parts and the journey

paragraphs.en: We built the app in Android Studio with functions separated into modules. I ran unit tests for individual features and integration tests that followed the overall visitor flow, checking how search, planning, and navigation worked together.
paragraphs.zh: 应用在 Android Studio 中开发，各项功能拆分为独立模块。单元测试检查单项功能，集成测试则模拟完整游览流程，确认搜索、规划与导航能否顺利衔接。

caption.en: Zoo Navigator animal search and visit planner
caption.zh: 动物园导航 动物搜索与行程规划

design_question.en: How can a list of animals become a route a visitor can follow?
design_question.zh: 如何根据想看的动物安排游览路线？

overview.en: Paintings of ordinary life, and the feelings that linger within it. These works move between realism and abstraction, gathering fragments of memory, reflection, and quiet strangeness.
overview.zh: 这些画记录日常生活中久久不散的情绪，在写实与抽象之间，留下记忆、思绪，以及平静生活里不易察觉的异样。

caption.en: Sakya — 20" × 16", oil pastel & acrylic on canvas, 2024
caption.zh: 《释迦》｜20 × 16 英寸，布面油画棒与丙烯，2024

role.zh: 构思、绘画、程序与装置制作

overview.en: A self-portrait, abstract paintings, and projected images share a wall. A camera captures the paintings and wall projection live; YOLO and CLIP interpret the scene while visitors watch. What we recognize depends on what we bring to an image.
overview.zh: 自画像、抽象绘画与投影并置在墙上，摄像头将绘画与墙上的投影一起收入画面，交由 YOLO 和 CLIP 实时识别。观众驻足观看，也在各自的经验中辨认这些图像。同一张画，因观看者而有了不同的意味。

label.zh: 阅读论文《AI 结构主义》· PDF，13 页

caption.en: Installation view: paintings, projection, and a live machine reading
caption.zh: 装置现场：绘画、投影与实时识别

paragraphs.en: A friend may recognize the person before noticing the painting. A stranger may first see a face, a surface, or a collection of marks. The models approach the same image through learned visual patterns and a set of labels. Each reading belongs to a different web of relationships. “Machinery structuralism” is my way of bringing them into the same space.
paragraphs.zh: 熟悉的人也许先认出我，陌生人看到的则可能是一张脸，或画布上的色块。识别模型依据训练中形成的视觉关系和预设标签，给出另一种解释。“机械结构主义”由此追问：图像的意义，如何在这些不同的关系中形成？

caption.en: Portrait recognition study. CLIP scores show relative matches within the chosen label set.
caption.zh: 绘画识别实验。CLIP 分数表示图像与所选标签的相对匹配程度。

paragraphs.en: A sentence describing a face becomes the starting point for another image. Working from Aperture, I adapted an attention-map visualization to follow individual words across generation steps. In the film, facial features gather and disperse across eighteen small fields. Watching them together draws attention to the relationships between words and image regions.
paragraphs.zh: 一句对面孔的描述，成为生成图像的起点。借助改写后的 Aperture，文字在生成过程中对应的注意力图被逐步记录下来。十八个小格里，面孔从噪点中浮现，又在循环播放中散去，让文字与图像之间的联系变得可见。

caption.en: Attention maps across generation steps. Edited as a forward-and-reverse loop.
caption.zh: 逐词注意力图；正放与倒放组成循环。

paragraphs.en: Jim Campbell’s work encouraged me to think about light as part of an image’s physical presence. Projection let a canvas hold a painted image and a changing digital one at once.
paragraphs.zh: Jim Campbell 的作品让我留意，光如何影响我们辨认一幅图像。投影覆在画布上，绘画便有了另一层会变化的表面。

paragraphs.en: The first installation exposed a practical tension: room light kept the paint visible but weakened the projection; dimming the room made the projection clearer while hiding the painted surface. Small projected text was also difficult to read. This test made lighting, scale, and legibility central to the next iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 实际布展时，明亮的环境削弱了投影，暗下来又看不清笔触；投影文字也偏小。这次尝试，让光照、画幅和文字尺度成了后续调整的重点。

caption.en: A second recognition test using a few painted facial marks
caption.zh: 用简化的五官色块测试识别结果

process_note.en: Earlier experiments included reconstructing a lemon from frames of Hollis Frampton’s Lemon (1969). The essay follows these studies and the ideas that connect them to the installation.
process_note.zh: 前期还尝试过从 Hollis Frampton 的《柠檬》（1969）中提取画面、重建三维形体。论文记录了这些实验，以及它们如何逐渐汇入装置的构思。
